_comment: ArtifactTransaction placement: one guarded mutation aggregate per declared GlobalRoot target set. Persistence: content-addressed stages, captured pre-state, root lease, and append-only audit. Concurrency: one active root lease; losers fail closed.

_ignores.acquireLease: source bytes have not been sealed and verified
_ignores.leaseDenied: lease acquisition has not been attempted
_ignores.staleHash: live hashes are checked during lease acquisition
_ignores.commit: the root lease is not owned
_ignores.crash: no lease or target mutation exists to recover
_ignores.recoverySucceeded: no expired lease or incomplete rollback exists

_ignores.stage: source bytes are already sealed and verified
_ignores.staleHash: live hashes are checked while acquiring the lease
_ignores.commit: the root lease is not owned
_ignores.crash: no lease or target mutation exists to recover
_ignores.recoverySucceeded: no expired lease or incomplete rollback exists

_ignores.acquireLease: the aggregate already owns the only active lease for this root
_ignores.reject: a leased transaction commits or explicitly records stale-hash rejection
_ignores.leaseDenied: this aggregate already acquired the root lease
_ignores.recoverySucceeded: the lease has not expired and no incomplete recovery exists

_ignores.stage: source bytes are already immutable before commit
_ignores.reject: an active commit follows deterministic commit or rollback outcomes
_ignores.acquireLease: the aggregate already owns the active root lease
_ignores.leaseDenied: the aggregate already owns the active root lease
_ignores.staleHash: pre-hashes were verified immediately before commit
_ignores.commit: atomic replacement is already in progress
_ignores.rollbackSucceeded: rollback starts only after commit or audit failure
_ignores.rollbackFailed: rollback starts only after commit or audit failure
_ignores.recoverySucceeded: operator recovery starts only after an expired owner or failed rollback

_ignores.stage: rollback uses only captured pre-state bytes
_ignores.reject: rollback has deterministic success or operator-recovery outcomes
_ignores.acquireLease: the aggregate already owns the active root lease
_ignores.leaseDenied: the aggregate already owns the active root lease
_ignores.staleHash: captured pre-state is the sole restoration authority
_ignores.commit: a failed commit must not retry inside the same transaction
_ignores.crash: rollback failure, rather than ordinary crash, determines recovery
_ignores.recoverySucceeded: operator recovery starts only after rollback failure

_ignores.acquireLease: an existing lease must be recovered or released before new acquisition
_ignores.leaseDenied: recovery resolves the existing lease rather than retrying acquisition
_ignores.staleHash: recovery verifies explicit current hashes before terminal success and cannot cure stale bytes
_ignores.commit: a recovering transaction must never install bytes without a fresh pre-hash verification
_ignores.auditFailed: no terminal transaction audit append is active
_ignores.rollbackSucceeded: the failed rollback requires operator reconciliation first
_ignores.rollbackFailed: rollback already failed and recovery is active
_ignores.crash: recovery is already the safe state for an expired owner
